newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish net reserves fall to $21.24 bln March 1-10. [corrected 11:00 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Polish net reserves fall to $21.24 bln March 1-10. [corrected 11:00 GMT]

text.p: Polish net foreign currency reserves fell by $308.6 million in March 1-10 to $21.24 billion and were $350 million lower than a year ago, the National Bank of Poland said.
It said net reserves (corrects from "official reserves") fell $429.3 million in the January-March 10 period compared to a $1.15 billion rise in the corresponding period of last year.
POLISH RESERVES (bln dlr) MARCH 10 FEB MARCH 10 96
NOTE - Figures in billions of dollars. Official reserves are those held by the state. Net reserves mean the total amount of hard currencies in the whole banking system.
